ambient_events: Somewhere behind the racking, a compressor starts, runs for four seconds, and stops.
A radio is playing something with too much reverb on it, two rooms away and turned down.
Dust comes off the roof sheets in a slow drift wherever the light gets in.
Somebody walks the length of the shed, unhurried, and does not come back.
The board by the desk gets a new card pinned to it. Nobody watches it go up.
description: The shed floor, high enough to stand a trailer in and long enough to stand three. Diesel, cold iron and the ghost of somebody's lunch. Trucks nose-in along one wall under a strip light with a flicker in it; along the other, racking, pallets, and a desk with a board over it — freight going out, prices coming in, and a chalked column of what the exchange is paying today. The door stands open on the road south.
name: Last Requisition — the shed
